note: Curated PQC roadmap claims for the delegated / blocked-external class.

vendors.name: OpenSSL (OS provider)
vendors.claim: 3.5 LTS ships ML-KEM/ML-DSA/SLH-DSA; the current OS major defaults to it.
vendors.watch: FIPS provider 3.5 adoption across base images

vendors.name: Go toolchain / stdlib
vendors.claim: go>=1.24: hybrid X25519MLKEM768 TLS default and a FIPS 140-3 module with ML-KEM; ML-DSA not yet in stdlib.

vendors.name: go-jose (JOSE/JWT)
vendors.claim: JOSE PQC algorithm identifiers pending IETF (JOSE/COSE ML-DSA drafts).
vendors.watch: IETF JOSE ML-DSA registration; a go-jose release adopting it

vendors.name: rustls / Rust TLS stack
vendors.claim: X25519MLKEM768 via the aws-lc-rs provider in 0.23.x; ring-backed builds stay classical.

vendors.name: pyca/cryptography + Python ssl
vendors.claim: Transport inherits the linked OpenSSL; ML-KEM/ML-DSA primitives are not in the stable API.

vendors.name: Code forge (App JWT RS256)
vendors.claim: The forge mandates RS256 for App JWTs; tokens are minutes-lived (no harvest risk).
